issue.title: Conflict between Resource class attribute and new almanac interface endpoints

summary.text: The verifier reproduced the original bug, but six existing tests in phabricator/tests/test_phabricator.py (including test_connect, test_user_whoami, test_validation and test_endpoint_shadowing) passed before the fix and fail after it, which is a counterexample against this change. Look first at why these previously passing tests now fail, starting with test_endpoint_shadowing and test_connect, si…
